concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-online-payments-currency-conversion-refunds-your-user]] — 2026-09-15 limited-availability Platforms FX-refund pilot guide for booking the processing-versus-settlement-currency remainder to the user's balance account through original or rate-adjusted splits.
warnings: Pilot availability, credentials, capabilities and Support setup are conditional; example requests and received responses are not live refund or shopper-receipt proof.

The separate split-refunds guide warns that invalid or closed-holder balance-account targets may fall back to the platform liable balance; do not read this page's guaranteed-splits phrasing as overriding that caveat.
This page does not specify a separate partial-refund procedure or universal payment-method support.
